newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Escudo ends weaker vs mark, could dip further.
newsitem.headline: Escudo ends weaker vs mark, could dip further.

text.p: 1705 GMT - The escudo ended weaker against the mark, accompanying the fall of the peseta, in a session in which buyers of marks were predominant, dealers said. They said the buying interest in marks could continue tomorrow, although fears of Bank of Portugal intervention could arise if the escudo slips towards 101.0 per mark. The escudo ended at 100.83/86 per mark, compared with 100.68/71 at the opening.
